issue.standard_remedy: Harmonize prices to the best plant / global agreement
issue.summary: Pays 1.6% on average above the best plant for the same materials

plan.diagnosis: Suzhou plant pays an average 1.6% premium above best-plant pricing across 238 materials sourced from Meridian Industrial (Suzhou) in SAP S/4HANA, resulting in USD 497,922 excess spend over the trailing 12 months. Root cause is lack of price harmonization and absence of global or multi-plant pricing agreements that would leverage consolidated buying power.

remedy_steps.step: Conduct detailed price benchmarking analysis across all plants for the 238 materials to identify best-achieved pricing by material and validate the USD 497,922 savings opportunity
Engage Meridian Industrial (Suzhou) with consolidated spend data across all plants and negotiate global or regional pricing agreement targeting best-plant parity pricing
Update SAP S/4HANA master data with negotiated pricing: create/update INFO records with new conditions, implement validity dates, and establish cross-plant source list entries where applicable
Configure automated price variance alerts in SAP (>2% deviation from target) and establish monthly price compliance review process across all plants
Monitor actual savings realization through PO analysis and conduct supplier performance review at 90 days post-implementation

plan.expected_impact: Harmonizing Suzhou plant pricing to best-plant levels across 238 materials will generate USD 497,922 in annual savings.
kpis: Average price premium vs. best plant (target: 0% from current 1.6%)
Realized savings tracked monthly (target: USD 497,922 annualized)
Percentage of 238 materials harmonized to best-plant pricing (target: 100%)
Price variance exceptions by material (target: <5% of SKUs >1% variance)
risks: Meridian Industrial may resist price reduction without consolidated volume commitment across plants
Regional supply constraints or service level differences may justify price variations for certain materials
Implementation delays in SAP master data updates could defer savings realization
Currency fluctuation (CNY/USD) may impact pricing comparison accuracy and agreement terms
erp_actions: SAP S/4HANA: Update INFO records (ME12) for all 238 materials with negotiated target prices and validity dates
SAP S/4HANA: Create cross-plant source list entries (ME01) to enforce preferred pricing and supplier for harmonized materials
SAP S/4HANA: Configure price variance tolerance (transaction OMR6) at 2% threshold to trigger approval workflow for Suzhou plant purchases
SAP S/4HANA: Establish purchasing value key (SPRO configuration) to flag harmonized materials for monitoring and reporting
Multi-ERP: Replicate harmonized pricing to Oracle EBS, Dynamics 365, and NetSuite for materials cross-sourced at other locations
